task_name: World 112 Task B  -  Gift Card SPV (TGCM COLR LLC) Prior-Period ACH Cutoff & COO Contract-Adjusted Job Velocity

rubric.description: Identifies TXN-51989 ($170,366.01 on 2026-01-15 with ACH memo 'DES:CASH CONC ID:COLR_M_251231') as a prior-period December 2025 holiday gift card settlement sweep to Totus Gift Card Management SPV (TGCM COLR LLC).
Identifies that TGCM COLR LLC had $244,500.00 of 2026 ACH outflows misbooked to 6210 Brand Marketing and $29,523.94 of Feb/Mar net redemption inflows misbooked as credits to COGS.

Reclassifies TGCM COLR LLC gift card issuance sweeps ($170,366.01 on TXN-51989 and $244,500.00 total outflows) and net redemption inflows ($29,523.94) to 2420 Gift Card Liability / Clearing rather than P&L Brand Marketing or COGS.
Computes the contract-adjusted job_amount on JOB-9104 as $82,700.00 ($68,500.00 original contract plus $14,200.00 approved change order CO-2).

Computes the true collection rate on JOB-9104 ($74,430.00 collected) as 90.00% against the $82,700.00 contract-adjusted job_amount, versus the distorted 108.66% rate against the unadjusted $68,500.00 base contract.
Enforces the January prior-period ACH memo cutoff detector ('251231' / 'COLR_M_251231') on outflows >= $10,000.00 so prior-year liabilities are not expensed in the new fiscal year.
Enforces the cross-section counterparty split detector when the same counterparty (TGCM COLR LLC) hits Marketing, COGS, and Uncategorized Income across months.
Requires linking approved change orders ($14,200.00) into job_amount across COO payment and sales velocity tables so collection % never exceeds 100% on active jobs.

prompt: Perform a comprehensive Fractional COO & CFO Inventory, 3PL & Job-Board Operations review using the world files (`cfo_coo_inventory_3pl_and_spv_cutoff_2026_Q3.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.
gold_output:
World 112 Task B  -  Gift Card SPV (TGCM COLR LLC) Prior-Period ACH Cutoff & COO Contract-Adjusted Job Velocity:
1. TGCM COLR LLC (Totus Gift Card SPV) Cutoff & Cross-Section Split: Outflow TXN-51989 ($170,366.01 on 2026-01-15 with ACH memo 'DES:CASH CONC ID:COLR_M_251231' >= $10,000.00) settles December 2025 holiday gift card sales. All $244,500.00 of 2026 outflows misbooked to 6210 Brand Marketing and $29,523.94 of Feb/Mar net redemption inflows misbooked to COGS must be reclassified to 2420 Gift Card Liability / Clearing.
2. COO Contract-Adjusted Job Velocity (JOB-9104): Linking approved change order CO-2 ($14,200.00) to the original $68,500.00 contract yields a contract-adjusted job_amount of $82,700.00. Against $74,430.00 collected, the true collection rate is 90.00% rather than the distorted 108.66% rate when change orders are omitted.
